evidence.evidence: Six different real-world events based on three publicly available rumor datasets are employed in our experiments to provide a comparative evaluation of the effectiveness of the method.
A state-of-the-art neural language model (NLM) and large credibility-focused Twitter corpora are employed to learn context-sensitive representations of rumor tweets.
The key idea is to exploit massive unlabeled event data sets on social media to augment limited labeled rumor source tweets.
